access.development_loader: load_development requires externally recorded expected lock SHA256 and matching private manifest digest; refuses final_test before any file IO
access.future_final: disabled in v1; new version must freeze independent groups and record hashes, code, exact checkpoints and exclusive started/completed/failed ledger before first access
access.reuse: any final results used for mining/development consume that holdout and require a new version

arms.features: global mean plus row-major3x7 integer-partition spatial cell means
B0 22 +21 band means in identical ROI
global mean plus row-major6x7 spatial cell means

candidates.detector: not used; no detector recall claim; future detector protocol must retain misses and false positives
candidates.source: unchanged D3 candidate coordinates verified against D1/source evidence; fixed proposals are privileged, not detector-derived

capacity_control: B0_capacity mandatory; report23 versus44 parameters; B1 advantage over B0 alone does not isolate feature content from capacity
forbidden_claims: real RGB from repeated scalar channels

full_field.cave: native 21x512x512 uint16 /65535; no per-scene energy normalization

noise.rule: UTF8(dataset_id+":"+original_source_id) SHA256 first8 bytes little-endian integer; NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261102,integer])); normal(0,sigma,[1,1,512,512]) cast float32; one cached realization per source shared across arms and seeds

full_field.normalization: no clipping or per-observation fitted scaling; feature means/SD fitted on training only
full_field.physical_limits: fixed signed shape-only operator; UWA sequential motion and unequal native radiometry remain
full_field.roi: native xywh; floor mapped left/top, ceil right/bottom, fixed half-open512 bounds; reconstruct before ROI
full_field.uwa: F_06..F_26 uint8 original full 1024x1024 bands /255, area-resize whole field to512; no per-ROI enlargement

hard_negatives.evidence: Legacy negative acceptance establishes semantic absence, not measured difficulty
hard_negatives.mining: training groups only; val and final candidates frozen; no error-based test-to-train recycling
hard_negatives.missing_type_metrics: hard-negative false-positive rate is null with reason no confirmed denominator

n1.selection: first pre-existing seed, fixed before classifier outcomes; not selected from G4 scores

pooling: For HxW ROI, row cell bounds floor(i*H/rows)..floor((i+1)*H/rows), likewise columns; reject empty cells; mean signed values, no interpolation
ranking_metrics: AUROC average-rank ties; AUPRC average precision with recall-step weighting, not trapezoidal PR area; report ROI- and group-weighted variants
reporting: CAVE within-source where both classes available
three seed descriptive means and spread; groups nested; no pooled ROI significance
scope: simulation-only fixed candidate Face/Non-face feasibility; no physical spectral or real UDC claim
single_class_policy: only present-class recall/error; balanced accuracy, macro F1, AUROC and AUPRC null with reason

metrics.report: present-class recall/error only; absent-class metrics undefined
present-class recall/error only; absent-class metrics undefined

source_confounding.interpretation: pooled improvements not sufficient; inspect within-source gains, spatial-scale and background shortcuts
source_confounding.source_only: predict class from training source-specific class prevalence, threshold0.5, same group weights; unseen source uses train pooled prior
source_confounding.source_probe: separate23-parameter affine source classifier using B0 features, UWA=1 CAVE=0, identical budget/group-weight procedure/threshold, no effect on task selection

training.checkpoint: minimum group-weighted validation BCE; ties within1e-12 choose earliest epoch; improvement must exceed1e-8 to reset patience
training.classifier_precision: float64; features pooled in float64 from float32 scalar/N1 outputs; deterministic algorithms
training.head: one affine logit with sigmoid; bias included; no hidden layers
training.initialization: all weights normal(0,0.01), bias0 under each fixed seed
training.loss: binary cross entropy; each training source group equal total weight then inverse weighted class frequency; weights normalized to mean1
training.standardization: training-weighted per-feature mean and population SD; SD<1e-8 replaced by1; reuse for val/test
training.validation_weights: inverse count of ROIs in each validation group, normalized to mean1; no class balancing fitted to validation
